The woman with the clay tube.fixed: Threaded woman of eighty with a face like a walnut: deeply wrinkled brown-tan skin, thin white hair pulled back in a low bun, small sharp dark eyes, thin dry mouth; slate-grey high-collared suit; thin pale scars at the temple; smokes a clay tube (clove-water). Expressions: claywoman_dry, claywoman_wry.

The girl with the harpoon.fixed: Threaded girl of about nineteen, olive-tan skin, black hair cut short at the jaw, thin stubborn face, dark eyes; slate-grey high-collared suit with a pale piping at the collar; thin pale scars at the temple; carries a harpoon. Expressions: harpoongirl_angry, harpoongirl_bitter.

The young man from Fallow.fixed: Threaded young man of about twenty-four (the last Jef made before Wrack, six years ago), light skin, sandy-brown hair, lean face, scars at the temples hardly faded; plain grey-green tunic. Expressions: fallowyoung_ashamed, fallowyoung_sorry.

Nerys.fixed: Ilan's mother, a mariner living dry in Saltgate (memory), about forty, slender and long-limbed, pale light skin, black hair pinned in a low bun, large dark eyes; plain dark high-collared dress with long sleeves buttoned to the wrists. Expressions: nerys_earnest, nerys_worn.

Adler Crane.fixed: Halcyon's chief of security (memory), about forty-five, broad-shouldered, olive-pale skin, short brown hair going grey at the sides, square jaw, tired brown eyes; plain dark close-fitting high-necked security jacket. Expressions: crane_flat, crane_sorry.

Dace.fixed: Driftfolk woman of about fifty (out of Lashing), long weather-beaten tanned face with deep creases, grey-brown hair tied back, a clay pipe in her teeth, a soft hat tied on with string under the chin, worn patched olive canvas coat. Expressions: dace_cheerful (base), dace_dry, dace_pain. Ch09 adds dace_grave and dace_questioning from the same look.

Yeva.fixed: the Wellwalker, tall lean woman of about sixty-five with a long worn face, weathered olive-tan skin, long grey hair tied back loosely, dry manner; plain worn grey-green sea-silk tunic. Expressions: yeva_dry (base), yeva_stern, yeva_tired.

Pell.fixed: thin nervous young man of about twenty-five, a filing clerk of the Clean Hands, pale light skin, neat short dark-brown hair, narrow face; pale-grey jacket over a shirt and dull tie. Expressions: pell_nervous, pell_earnest.

Linnea Marsh.fixed: physician and chief of Brightwater, about sixty-five, light skin, short practical grey hair, fine lines, calm exact face; plain dark raincoat with the collar turned up. Expressions: marsh_flat, marsh_hesitant, marsh_humble.

Garran.fixed: big slow dock porter of about forty with a broken nose, tan weathered skin, short dark hair, dark stubble, thick neck; coarse sleeveless olive work shirt with a rope over one shoulder. Expressions: garran_wary, garran_accepting.

Wrack (ch08 variants).fixed: same Wrack with the Thread line on the neck. With hat (from c08.s01, Dace gives it): plain soft dark-grey short-brimmed hat, tunic: wrack_hat_guarded, wrack_hat_melancholy, wrack_hat_calm. In the Brightwater suit (c08.s05): dark charcoal business suit, white shirt, loosened tie, no hat: wrack_suit_cool, wrack_suit_sorrowful. Without hat: wrack_thread_wry, wrack_thread_straining.

Teodora Raske.fixed: small slight woman of sixty, chief designer of Kessler-Vane, short grey bobbed hair, light skin with fine lines, thin steel-rimmed spectacles, brown eyes, sharp tired intelligent face; plain dark work jacket over a white shirt with ink-stained cuffs and collar. Expressions: raske_stern, raske_shocked, raske_moved (shaken), raske_steady.

The hull man.fixed: grey, stooped man of about sixty-five, a section head under Raske, thin grey hair, short grey goatee, deep lines, light skin, hunched heavy shoulders; dark work coat with a worn brown collar. Expression: hullman_steady.

The woman from engines.fixed: woman of about forty-five, a section head, dark brown hair pinned back with loose strands, light olive skin, brown eyes, plain dark work smock with rolled sleeves; old healed burn scars on the backs of her hands and forearms (subtle, same skin colour, slightly shinier). Expressions: enginewoman_guarded, enginewoman_weeping.
The woman from engines.note: fal's filter rejects strong scar wording; say 'subtle streaks of old healed skin, only slightly paler and shinier, same skin colour'. Strong wording gave purple or white blotches.

The fat old man in the striped jersey.fixed: fat old man of about seventy, Driftfolk harbour caller of Lashing, round heavy jowled face, white stubble beard, thin white hair, weathered skin; blue knitted jersey with cream stripes; carries a brass trumpet under his arm (not drawn in the portrait). Expression: fatman_unhappy.

objects.Maker lamp: pale ivory metal column as thick as a man's waist, a few ribbed collars, old bundled cables down one side, caged glass lens housing near the top, hairline seam at shoulder height polished by touch; dark when dead, lens blazes white when lit. Once lit it stays lit. Wall/dome lamps use the same design on a short post.
objects.Halcyon diving gear: grey armoured diving suits, metal helmets with round glass faceplates, a stripe for officers, blue shield crest; they ride squat ugly grey sleds with caged screws and carry harpoon guns
objects.The needle (Okonta's vehicle): a sliver of pale silver metal three times the length of a man, no thicker than a kelp stem, pointed at both ends, no rudder, no screw, no window; a soft light runs along its flank like the light on a fish; it is steered by the rider leaning, with nothing in the hands; two ride clinging on its back
objects.The Dragon: a river with a spine: a kilometre of pale metal ribs, each a hoop taller than a hold's dome, one behind another in a long sinuous line, with bright dense glowing water BOUND to the ribs, pouring forward along the frame without leaving it, like a flame streaming back from a torch; the head is a smooth blunt pale prow the size of a house with no eyes and no mouth, and a panel that slides open like an eyelid; inside, the gallery is a flooded still hall with walls of bound water
objects.Slick eel: eyeless eel as thick as a man's body and as long as a needle, coated in black slime, pale sores where the slime has rubbed away, jaws opening like a split hose
objects.White whales: six white, vast, blunt-headed whales, each as long as a ship, small wise eyes; the calf is no bigger than a fishing boat; old scars on the mother's flank
objects.Warm-stone: a smooth dark egg-shaped stone about the size of a loaf, on a small stand when kept; glows with a soft warm amber light from within once mended (c09.s02.p015.1). Draw it as one egg-shaped stone, never several.

places.Low Anthem dome: hill-sized dome of pale smooth curved panes held by seamless white metal ribs; lit on one half, dark on the other with strings of glowing yellow-green lampweed; kelp trained up one side; stone-walled terraces and raked kelp rows round it; the hold is UNDER the sea
places.Kelp forest: brass-coloured trunks thick as a man's waist, no branches, golden blades far above leaning one way, green at the edges and gold in the middle
places.Barge: rusty steel cargo barge about forty metres long; crew wear black sailor uniforms; Halcyon boats carry a blue shield-shaped crest on the bow (design is a choice)
places.The Tangle: wild kelp so thick the stems rub and groan, light failing a few metres in; wrecks of agravar warships two hundred years old lying on their sides, furred with weed, fish in the gun-ports, a skull in a rusted helmet
places.Sounding (ruin): a broken hold, a dome three times the size of Low Anthem's broken open like an egg, half standing; pale ribs curving up into the dark, silt floor, stumps of walls, a stair of six steps going up to nothing; a ring of bare sand all round with no weed
places.The Slick edge: the kelp stops at a line as sharp as a shoreline; rows of dead black bitterwrack a hundred metres deep; beyond, water the colour of strong tea with shreds hanging in it
places.Greywatch Stone: bare rise above the forest where kelp will not grow and the current runs cold and strong; a six-sided pillar of pale Maker stuff twice a man's height, nothing on it; a ring of stone benches and the paving scratched with thousands of worn names in looping script (never readable); a small camp of nets and a cooking-stone in a lee hollow
places.Dragon gallery: flooded warm hall a kilometre long, ribs arching to a point of light, no walls, only bound water pouring past; hammock-nets, cooking stones, a rack of dried fish, a band of scratched names along the floor; cradles shaped to needles low in the belly, each with a name, one empty with silt; closed hull, no outside view of sky or land
places.Rime: a Maker dome hung upside down from the underside of an ice shelf, glowing amber, little lights moving beneath it
places.The Well lip: curved shelf of smooth dark rock at the edge of a vast round black shaft of perfectly still water, soft glowing pale green weed along the rim, pale blue lantern jellies as big as houses drifting over the gulf; at the bottom a single white star (the Lantern)
places.Kettle House: low stone house half in water and half out on a rock shelf, pigeon-breast sky with a low red sun, washing line stiff with frost, shell-edged weed garden, workshop with its door open, kettle on the step; no fence or gate
places.Kettle House interior: one long stone room, iron stove at one end, long mended table of mixed planks, jar shelves, box bed behind a curtain, loft ladder, window onto black water and jellies, fist-sized pale jelly in a glass bowl
places.Workshop: untidy stone room, benches heaped with lamps in pieces, a lamp's heart laid open, coils of warm pale wire, small worn tools on one wall, a stool and a mug
places.The Lantern: nine milk-white glass domed halls in a ring joined by covered ways, lit from within, standing at the bottom of a black rock shaft like a crown of lamps; white fans and pale flowers; inside, halls with round pools of faintly gold water and stools; four halls dark and dry
places.Jef's workshop (after his death): untidy stone-walled workshop, benches heaped with lamps in pieces and coils of wire, a dead barrel-sized pale ribbed air-heart laid out in pieces beside a dark oval warm-stone, a white mug with a dried tea stain left untouched, grey window light, nothing lit
places.The landing (evening): smooth dark stone landing with wide steps into black still water, low stone wall, patches of snow and ice, deep blue dusk sky with a last faint light
places.Open sea with ice shelf (the ride south): cold deep-blue open sea, the underside of an ice shelf like an upside-down country of pale ridges and hanging valleys, shafts of light, a few luminous pale singers; entirely underwater
places.Deep Chorus canyon: a gulf a kilometre wide cut into the golden kelp forest floor, tiers of long pale-glass galleries down both walls, slender bridges wall to wall, hanging weed gardens; white light above the twentieth tier, dark below with greenish-yellow lampweed; entirely underwater
places.Deep Chorus canyon, lit to the sixtieth: same canyon, warm white lamps lit down both walls to one tier, black dark windows below, bottom lost in blue; entirely underwater
places.Deep Chorus high hall: third tier council hall, vault of clear glass with green canyon water beyond, pale shell-inlaid floor in a wave pattern, seven plain stone seats in an arc, white lamps on short ivory posts; dry
places.Deep Chorus service tunnels: narrow rough stone tunnels behind the galleries, old pipes, a worn stair, failing lamps, swags of weak yellow-green lampweed; dry
places.Deep Chorus lowest dry halls: long low dry halls in the green dimness, swags of glowing lampweed on the ceiling, rows of sleepers on mats and blankets; dry, stale
places.Deep Chorus heart-chamber: vast dim stone vault, a house-sized pale ribbed air-heart like a great closed shell furred with grey dust, thick water channels on both sides, a door with a broken wax seal; dry
places.Deep Chorus sea-door on the rim: bare dry stone chamber with a round sea-door pool in the floor and a wide arch of glass onto the golden kelp forest beyond; dry
places.Dragon gallery, failing (ch6): same hall as the Dragon gallery but dim: the bound-water walls thinned to a film with dark open sea in the gaps; slack hammock-nets; a double row of needle-shaped vessels asleep in cradles (bg c6_gallery_failing). Never any sky or horizon.
places.Dragon gallery, stern (ch6): dim evening end of the hall, the last cradle against the wall with a square name cut in the rib beside it (bg c6_gallery_stern).
places.Dragon gallery, nineteen needles (ch6): morning hall, nineteen needles in a row built for two hundred, one worn wheel lashed to a rib (bg c6_gallery_nineteen).
places.Dragon's heart under the floor: cramped patched chamber under the gallery floor, a wheel within a wheel within a wheel covered in layers of patches, one lampweed strand hanging, silt on the floor (bg c6_heart_under).
places.Kelp, gold then black: brass kelp lit gold on the left going to black on the right (bg c6_kelp_gold_black); underwater.
places.Inside the Slick: strong-tea brown dead water, ragged shreds hanging motionless, silt floor with low mounds (bg c6_slick_inside); underwater.
places.Forest beneath the bound water: golden kelp forest seen below a bright bound-water surface (bg c6_forest_beneath); underwater.
places.Dragon gallery, brown snow (ch7): the gallery hall with the bound-water wall dark brown outside and grey snow falling, a bottle, a shoe, paper among it; one faint lamp far down the hall (bg c7_gallery_snow).
places.Dragon gallery, Bright Shelves (ch7): the hall with the wall clear as glass over white sand, green grass meadows, schools of small silver fish, glass coral thickets, sunlight from above (bg c7_gallery_shelves).
places.Nine Spires from the sea (ch7): calm turquoise sea, nine slender white towers far off on the horizon, small sailboats round their feet (bg c7_nine_spires); above water.
places.The landing in hot fog (ch7): stone landing and black water in thick white fog, the Dragon's ribs looming faintly (bg c7_fog_landing).
places.The Smokers (ch7): deep black clear water, fields of crooked stone chimneys with black plumes glowing red at the root, red tube gardens, pale crabs and blind white fish (bg c7_smokers); underwater.
places.Ember House, fog (ch7): twin of Kettle House on a black sand islet, hot springs smoking, garden in the shallows, kettle on the step, cairn of black stones with a folded leather apron (bg c7_ember_house).
places.Ember House, dusk (ch7): same islet at dusk, low red sun and a red road across black water (bg c7_ember_dusk).
places.The Hush (ch7): windowless black stone building, no lamps, faint embers at its base (c7_hush_exterior); dark hall with shallow pools (c7_hush_hall); small bare room with one ember in a dish (c7_hush_room); dark water above it with rays turning in a ring (c7_hush_above). All underwater.
places.Memory places (ch7): Saltgate fourth-floor kitchen with a basin of water under the table (c7_saltgate_kitchen); school classroom on the Sluice (c7_sluice_school); Concord windowless dining room with a covered fish (c7_concord_room); Halcyon surveyor's office over grey ash plain (c7_halcyon_office); survey ship control hall at night (c7_control_hall_night).
places.Belt, grey twilight (underwater): cold grey-green water looking up at a heaving surface with dim shafts of light (bg c8_belt_under); underwater.
places.Belt, rain walls: open sea from a boat's bow under a bruised purple-grey sky with walls of rain (bg c8_belt_rain).
places.Eye of the storm: the patched boat on pale sea-green glassy water under a round ring of blue sky inside a circular cloud wall (bg c8_eye_boat).
places.Boat in black rain: the patched boat among steep grey sea hills in rain (bg c8_boat_storm).
places.Saltgate: a hundred black sea-stacks built over with tiers of buildings, neon signs of abstract shapes, evening rain (bg c8_saltgate).
places.Saltgate lock: open rusted iron gates between barnacled pilings, empty glass boxes above lit with neon (bg c8_lock).
places.Canal wall with the poster: stone wall across a canal with a weathered poster showing a plain-faced black-haired man, no lettering (bg c8_poster_canal).
places.Wet Market: roofed basin, three tiers of stalls, lowest a metre under water, lamps on chains (bg c8_wet_market); lowest tier with plank table and basins (bg c8_market_low).
places.The Sluice: narrow back canal, leaning tenements, washing lines, noodle stall with a plain curtain, one lit fourth-floor window (bg c8_sluice).
places.Noodle shop window: window sill, the tower across the canal with the blue drop and sun sign (bg c8_noodle_window).
places.Brightwater Wellness Centre: thirty-storey white-tiled tower, fountain plaza, blue drop and smiling sun sign (bg c8_brightwater_ext); white lobby (c8_lobby); tank room with an empty glass cylinder (c8_tank_room); flooded emergency stair (c8_stair_flooded); loading dock on the canal at night (c8_loading_dock).
places.Under the Wet Market: forest of barnacled pilings in calm blue-green tide water, plank ledge, lamp slits overhead (bg c8_under_market).
places.Saltgate north lock, night rain (ch9): iron lock gates open between tall lit tenements in heavy rain, a patched boat's wet deck with a lantern in the foreground (bg c9_lock_rain).
places.Keelhaven from the sea (ch9): plain of steel with comb-tooth slipways, rows of cranes, showering orange sparks and smoke under an orange sky (bg c9_keelhaven_night).
places.Coal wharf facing Slip Nine (ch9): black coal heaps and a bollard in front, across dark water a gigantic half-plated hull with ribs showing like a carcass and a square void amidships (bg c9_coal_wharf).
places.Kessler-Vane design loft (ch9): huge night hall, empty slanted drawing tables each under a green-shaded lamp, spiral stair (bg c9_design_loft).
places.Raske's office (ch9): untidy desk of drawings under a green-shaded lamp, shelf of ship models and awards with blank frames, one egg-shaped dark stone, window onto cranes (bg c9_raske_office).
places.Net loft over a chandler's shop (ch9): enclosed attic, sloping beams, hanging nets, a barrel, ladder hatch, one hanging lantern (bg c9_net_loft).
places.Old ferry stage (ch9): stone road and wooden stage in mist, dark armoured trucks at the top, yard tugs moored, floodlights, cranes (bg c9_ferry_stage).
places.Storm from a tug's bow (ch9): black rain, huge grey sea hills, a narrow strip of flatter water ahead (bg c9_tug_storm).
places.Eye of the storm, tugs side by side (ch9: ring of cloud wall, blue-green sky, green glassy water, tugs tied together, gale skates (bg c9_eye_tugs).
places.Lashing from the water (ch9): a mat of stormgrass a kilometre wide with roped hulls, a frigate hull market, thousands of lanterns at dusk (bg c9_lashing_water).
places.Barge deck at night (ch9): bare planks, lanterns hung in the rigging and along the rail, yellow oilskins hung up (bg c9_barge_night).
places.Soup barge (ch9): long plank tables of steaming bowls, a fire and a big pot, lanterns, blankets on benches (bg c9_soup_barge).
